task: FDD-022 (Scored-Search Decision Configuration Compilation): approve, reject, or request revision

criteria.description: traceable to brd adr: sections 2 and 3 implement BRU-022-01 to BRU-022-12. L1 to L8 were confirmed by Menno on 2026-10-30 as the options this FDD states, including L1 (resolver unchanged) and L6 (proposal file plus an adjudicated adopt command). ADR-022's body is not amended in this approval; section 4 names each departure.

placement and purity: weight_compiler.py is pure, imports decision types and PolicySnapshot, and does no storage or file I/O. The two commands do the file and store work. evaluate calls DecisionResolver.resolve(snapshot, with_weights(...)); the snapshot is the action space the resolver requires and is not read for criteria_weights.

no invented implementation: CompiledWeights.weights is stored as a MappingProxyType over a copy. A dataset item with a bad label or a missing field makes policy-compile-weights exit non-zero; the pure module does not open the file. The worked checks name values from DecisionResolver.
compatibility preserved: DecisionResolver is not changed. Online decisions apply frozen weights and run no search. Constraints, options and evidence are not changed by with_weights.
